summary: Iter12 verified the 3D redo of Blackjack/Baccarat/Pikapokeri/Casino War + shared theme system. 15/15 new pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Playwright runs on /asiakas (all 4 games dealt 3D cards via Three.js and resolved to outcome banners) and /operator (login, 5 tabs, theme editor, customer modal, points grant, audit/activity, shoes) succeeded with zero JS errors.

issues: Player & dealer cards overlap the 'Voitto +100 p' result banner — banner z-index is in front of the cards but visually the cards float over it; consider reserving banner space above the table or moving cards apart.
Result banner 'BLACKJACK! +300 p' overlaps the dealt cards instead of sitting clear above/below the table felt.
After 'Vaihda' the 5 cards bunch into the lower-right corner of the 3D table rather than centring across the felt; result banner 'Häviö' overlaps them.

Pikapokeri: re-centre the 5-card row after draw (cards currently cluster bottom-right).
(Non-blocking) customer.html is now ~1105 lines; per-game JS chunks can move to /static/js/customer/*.js for readability.
(Non-blocking) app.py is 3266 lines; split blackjack/baccarat/pikapokeri/war routes into a games blueprint.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/operator/theme silently ignores unknown keys — good; but it also silently coerces non-strings to skipped (no 400). Consider returning the list of rejected keys in the response for operator clarity.

/api/theme has no caching headers; it's called on every page load from both customer and operator surfaces. Set a short Cache-Control (e.g. max-age=30, must-revalidate) and a hash-based ETag to halve theme round-trips.
casino_3d.js (~496 lines) keeps a single global scene; calling createTableScene a second time without first calling .dispose() will leak a WebGL context. Confirm closeGame() invokes scene.dispose().
templates/customer.html mixes data-testid with onclick='loginCustomer()'-style inline handlers — fine for now but harder to tree-shake later. Consider moving to a single delegated listener.
Operator points modal returns to the customers table but the table refresh is full-fetch; with many players the +/- Pisteet flow will N+1. Patch the single row in-place instead.

rca of the issue: No defects found. The only call-out is cosmetic: in Blackjack/Pikapokeri/War the WebGL card meshes sometimes render on top of (overlapping) the DOM-overlay result banner, instead of beneath it. Likely cause: the result chip uses absolute positioning with default z-index inside the .scene-3d wrapper, but the Three.js <canvas> stacks above it because the canvas is appended last in createTableScene. Fix: give the result banner z-index higher than the canvas, or move it OUTSIDE the .scene-3d container in the templates.
